A hiring dashboard worth opening every week

A dashboard that nobody opens is just decoration. The ones I find useful answer a few plain questions: where is each role in the pipeline, how long are candidates waiting in each stage, and which sources lead to hires.

In Power BI I keep one page per audience. Hiring managers see their open roles and next steps. Leadership sees totals and trends. I see the detail underneath.

The habit that matters most is cleaning the ATS data before reporting on it. A stage that was never updated makes the chart look worse than the reality, and people stop trusting the numbers.
